endorsements.quote: Real-time data quality assessment systems that flag missing, inconsistent, or implausible entries at the point of documentation can substantially reduce downstream errors.

unlisted_practices: Embed data completeness into the design of health information systems and align it with equity, accountability, and patient safety.
Align reimbursement incentives with accurate and complete documentation while monitoring to avoid check-box behavior.
Provide patient portals that let patients review and correct their records, including medication and allergy lists.
Reduce clinician documentation burden through team-based documentation, medical scribes, and workflow and usability redesign.
Mandate standardized reporting and coding of diagnoses and medications, and coordinate regulatory mandates for HL7/FHIR adoption to reduce EHR fragmentation.
Characterize the missingness mechanism and its subgroup impact before applying imputation or other mitigation to EHR data.

screen.reason: This is a perspective paper discussing electronic health record incompleteness, its implications for bias in AI and machine learning systems, and proposing a framework and agenda for technical and governance mitigation.
